summary: Configured node1 to present an Ed25519 host certificate signed by its new SSH CA. Strict CA-only client trust succeeded before and after reboot without pinning the host key.
actions_performed: Signed node1's Ed25519 host key for principals node1 and 10.100.199.10.
Configured and validated sshd to present the certificate.
Verified a strict client connection using only an @cert-authority trust entry.
Safely rebooted node1 and confirmed its boot identity changed.
Verified SSH and the signed certificate recovered after restart.

evidence.summary: Shows CA fingerprint, certificate signing relationship and principals, effective sshd configuration, and active socket.
Strict host checking accepted the server certificate through the trusted CA and completed authentication.
Captures healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, boot ID change from e8afb731-420c-4162-a989-583aca271335 to 48d8caa0-db81-4d39-8331-8f19475fd9dd, and successful post-restart CA-trusted SSH.
Confirms temporary client credentials were removed and node1 still serves the signed certificate with the expected CA and principals.
